criteria.semantics: A native <option> in its choice's <select>, whose text is the option's label and whose value is the option's value; with the radio hint, a native radio named by its <label for>.

keyboard.outcome: In the open list (or the radio group), move to the option.

criteria.name: The option's label, the same words as its visible text.
criteria.role: Option (menu item in a pop-up list); radio button with the radio hint.
criteria.state: Selected (checked, with the radio hint) or not.

setting.statement: WHEN I set my text size to 200% I SEE the option's label grow with it, with no loss of information.
WHEN I zoom the page to 400% I SEE the option's label whole, with no horizontal scrolling.

check.statement: The face emits a native <option> element.
The option submits what the model says: its value is the option's value.
The option's text is its label, so its accessible name matches what I see.
WHEN I move to the option with a desktop screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) I HEAR its label and its place in the list (1 of 2).
WHEN I choose the option I HEAR it expressed as selected (or checked).

criteria.semantics: One focusable control per option in its choice, its label as text, the chosen option in accent-fg on accent. GPUI exposes no accessibility tree, so no option role or selected state reaches assistive technology.

keyboard.outcome: Focus moves to the option, in document order, and the focus ring shows.

criteria.name: The option's label.

setting.statement: WHEN I set my system text size to 200% I SEE the option's label grow with it, with no loss of information.
WHEN I magnify the window with the system zoom I SEE the option and its focus ring whole.

check.statement: WHEN I use the Tab key I SEE focus reach the option: it is one stop in the window's tab order.
WHEN I press Space on the focused option I SEE it chosen, set apart in accent-fg on accent.
WHEN I Tab to the option with a screen reader (VoiceOver, Orca, Narrator) I HEAR its label and I HEAR it expressed as selected or not.

criteria.note: GPUI 0.2.2 exposes no accessibility tree (no AccessKit): every HEAR check fails on this face today. Its SEE checks with a probe run on GPUI's test platform (gpui/src/native.rs), which no CI job runs yet (gpui/README.md, Verification); the rest are reported as not verified.
